name: Roasted Veggie, Dried Fruit & Pistachio Quinoa Bowl with Curry Yogurt
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces. Place on a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and cut the zucchini crosswise into thin rounds; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine the sauce.
Coarsely chop pistachios and place in another small bowl along with the raisins.
Medium dice apricots and add to the bowl with the pistachios; stir to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls and top with roasted veggies; sprinkle with fruit and nut mix. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
author: Mealime
